all_data_policy.collapse_gate: one aggregate report plus per-source breakdown; a source-specific collapse cannot be hidden by pooled averages
all_data_policy.dance_gate: AIST/JD/FD body supervision is masked privileged training only; it cannot create light labels
all_data_policy.full_contract_gate: only BeatSaver rows with bound MuQ+Base92 can enter the primary full-contract light arm
all_data_policy.source_adapter_gate: RPMC and other source-specific features require separate adapter/source_id and are scored separately for collapse

base92_contract.resampling: explicit timestamp alignment; light 40Hz blocks averaged to 10Hz; no tail replication
base92_contract.source_binding: same analyzed WAV sha256 as MuQ

old_recipe_findings: Old 52-D BodyToDMX/visual-bus experiments are not full Base92 and must remain source-tagged.
Old 8-song foundation used authentic MuQ layer9 + Base92; its Base92 is compatible with the raw 92-D cache after timestamp alignment.
The all300 target-only run used raw 92-D plus 1024 zero channels; that is invalid for foundation-v2 and is retained only as output-collapse negative control.

overlap_comparison.conclusion: same 92-D channel semantics; clock/storage dtype and timestamp binding remain explicit

classification: representation_collapsed only with latent diversity evidence
unqualified when two-song recomputation or provenance is missing

dance_auxiliary_contract.collapse_scope: dance loss does not override RGB/brightness/event output-collapse verdict; latent diversity and audio sensitivity remain required
dance_auxiliary_contract.mask_policy: apply auxiliary losses only when body and audio hash are authenticated; never fill missing dance with zeros or generated fallback
dance_auxiliary_contract.paired_control: target_only arm on the exact same grouped split and seed
dance_auxiliary_contract.teacher_sources: authenticated saved native-C body/body-derived motion proxy only

data_roster.all_data_rule: Use every corpus in its authenticated role through explicit source and modality masks. Do not merge incompatible x/y schemas into the full MuQ+Base92 contract, and do not use protected validation/test rows for training.

datasets.features: raw 92-D Base92; MuQ layer 9 to be extracted for 292 rows

datasets.muq_base92_status: unavailable: compact cache has no source waveform binding
datasets.policy: use only through explicit source adapter and source mask; never label as full MuQ+Base92
training-time dance auxiliary only; no authored-light target

datasets.features: authenticated MuQ/Base92 timelines and saved pose/body metadata
datasets.policy: train partitions only; protected validation/test remain held out; no authored-light target
bind by exact WAV hash before MuQ extraction; no filename-only pairing

model_input_contract.normalization: fit on training groups only; persist stats and hash

muq_contract.runtime_env: /root/lightsem/.venv/night-access (current snapshot symlinks are invalid; materialize loader path before extraction)
muq_contract.timestamp_contract: strictly increasing native 25Hz timestamps, overlap-stitch averaged, no extrapolated tail

scope: All currently available BeatSaver rows with authored audio+visual+light targets; dance body is permitted only as masked training-time auxiliary supervision on authenticated paired rows; no body inference, mapper, DMX, video, or product qualification.

split_contract.duplicate_policy: all exact-audio duplicates stay in one group; no cross-split leakage
split_contract.plan: 80/10/10 grouped train/dev/test after dedup; reserve validation rows before any training
split_contract.unit: unique audio/song group, not cache row

target_contract.rgb: authored RGB clipped only after auditing source range; 8 virtual fixture slots by explicit mapping
